slides.title:
Steal my
chest day
slides.sub:
4 exercises · 11 sets · ~45 min
Built for growth, not ego.

slides.name: Incline dumbbell press
slides.cue: Bench at 30°, not 45°. Lower until you feel a deep stretch.

slides.name: Barbell bench press
slides.cue: Shoulder blades pinched, feet planted, touch your lower chest.

slides.name: Weighted dips
slides.cue: Lean forward to load the chest. Go down until your shoulders are just below your elbows.

slides.name: Cable fly
slides.cue: Slight bend in the elbows. Stretch wide, squeeze together.
